title: The Market Is Hitting RECORD HIGHS… I'm Only Buying THESE Stocks
speaker: Ross Givens

macro_themes.view: A small group of stocks drives the index to highs while breadth deteriorates, so focus on leading groups.
Cybersecurity is the top-ranked group across 1-12 month windows.
Photonics is the next leg of the AI trade, helped by a US ban on Chinese manufacturers.

calls.reason: Index at a new all-time high but more net 52-week lows than highs, only ~56% of Nasdaq stocks above the 200-day, and a rolling-over A/D line.
calls.quote: even though the index itself is up, the market is in fact quite weak beneath the surface. Not saying we're going to crash.

calls.reason: Leader of the top-ranked cybersecurity group; breakout pattern triggered Sept 14 and ran from 230 to 280.
calls.quote: Now, the leader of this group, the big kahuna is Crowd Strike, ticker CRWD.

calls.reason: Breaking out through new highs with a similar pattern to CrowdStrike; sees it as more viable now.
calls.quote: The other big name, Palo Alto Networks, also breaking out through new highs. Much more viable, I think, than Crowd Strike.

calls.condition: buy stop triggers only on a break above yesterday's high (~13.10) at 13.25
calls.reason: Small-cap cyber name with series of shallowing consolidations after a 107% June move, institutions still buying; coiled spring.
calls.quote: if we trigger at 13 and a quarter, I'll be long RPD with a stop at 1190.

calls.reason: Midcap cyber stock with strong earnings and sales growth in a tight consolidation after a 140% move; number one group.
calls.quote: This thing looks absolutely perfect. There are no guarantees, but I have the number one group in the market.

notes: Recorded 8:08 CT Wednesday premarket; listing date used. Photonics stocks deferred to a separate video.
